answer: A falcon spots a fake flock by reading the flight, not the count. A newcomer earns standing by varnishing 14 violins over 30 days. Two luthiers from different workshops measure each coat to 0.1 millimeters and log it in the register. One coat off by more than 0.3 millimeters voids that violin's credit and pauses varnishing 14 days; three bad violins void the whole register. Faking 1,000 agents takes 14,000 violins, 28,000 checks and 420,000 bench days; one honest agent only keeps its varnish true. Trust grows like yarrow on a cliff path, slow and stubborn through the whole voyage.
